titulo: There's no engine in an electric car. So what moves it? ⚡ #howitworks #shorts
capa: NO ENGINE. SO WHAT MOVES IT?
descripcion:
An electric car has no engine and no gearbox. A battery, an inverter that flips the current thousands of times a second, and a spinning magnetic field do all the work. And when you brake, it all runs backwards.

What should we explain next?

#howitworks #electriccar #ev #tesla #engineering #science #shorts

lineas.texto: Open the hood of an electric car, and there's no engine. Just a trunk.
The power is under the floor: over four thousand battery cells.
But a battery only pushes current one way, and the motor needs it to flip.
So an inverter flips it back and forth, thousands of times every second.
That current hits three sets of copper coils, one after another, in a circle.
So the magnetic field spins around the motor, and drags the magnets in the rotor with it.
Flip faster, it spins faster. No gears to shift, ever.
Just one fixed gear: the motor turns about nine times for every turn of the wheel.
And when you lift your foot, it runs backwards: the wheels spin the motor, and it charges the battery.
Now you know. What should we explain next?
